title: If I Could Only Be an Airplane
targetPhonics: CVC short vowels (a, e, i, o, u)

reference_prompt:
9-PANEL STYLE REFERENCE SHEET for children's book illustration

FOCUS: Character design INCLUDING TRANSFORMATION, setting elements, color palette.
IMPORTANT: Transformation design in CENTER PANEL.

Row 1 - CHARACTER (normal):
[1] Jet standing: Young boy (5-6), messy brown hair, red t-shirt, khaki shorts, arms out like wings
[2] Jet expressions: Three small portraits - eyes shut dreaming, wide-eyed wonder, laughing joyfully
[3] Jet running: Same boy running through grass, arms stretched wide, hair blowing

Row 2 - TRANSFORMATION (center):
[4] Transformation start: Jet's arms beginning to become airplane wings, magical glow around him
[5] JET-AS-AIRPLANE (CENTER - biggest panel): Boy fully transformed into red airplane - his smiling face IS the nose cone, his arms ARE the wings, his body is the fuselage. Flying through blue sky. Surreal magical design.
[6] Jet-as-airplane flying: Same transformed airplane-boy soaring through fluffy white clouds, joyful expression

Row 3 - SETTING:
[7] Grassy hilltop: Green hill with tall grass, blue sky, where Jet sits and dreams
[8] Cloud interior: Inside a fluffy white cloud, soft and magical, droplets visible
[9] High altitude view: Tiny patchwork fields, miniature houses far below, clouds at eye level, golden sun

STYLE: Warm soft watercolor. Bright palette: sky blue, grass green, cloud white, RED (airplane/shirt). Surreal magical transformation aesthetic. Soft edges, no hard outlines.

CRITICAL: NO TEXT, NO WORDS, NO LETTERS anywhere.

base.description: 9-panel style guide with characters, settings, and key moments

scenes_part1.description: First half scenes (1-5): Hill observation and beginning of dream

scenes_part2.description: Second half scenes (6-10): Flying fantasy and return to reality

parent_tips.before_reading: Preview the cover together. Ask: What do you think this boy is dreaming about? Have you ever wished you could fly? Look for our special 'heart word': airplane.
parent_tips.during_reading: Help your child with 'airplane' and 'clouds' - these are special words we learn as wholes. Sound out the CVC words like: Jet, sits, hill, hot, sun, zips, dips, tips, spins, fast, fun, runs.
parent_tips.after_reading: Discuss: What did Jet imagine? How do you think it felt to fly so high? What would YOU see if you could fly like an airplane?

comprehension_questions.question: Where does Jet sit at the beginning?
comprehension_questions.answer: On a big hill in the sun

comprehension_questions.question: What does Jet wish he could be?
What does Jet do when he imagines being an airplane?
comprehension_questions.answer: He zips, dips, spins, and tips through the clouds

comprehension_questions.question: What brings Jet back to reality?
comprehension_questions.answer: His mom calling him - time to go

comprehension_questions.question: What is still up in the clouds at the end?
